div.div: لَتِىءٌ Remaining fixed, or keeping, to his place: (K:) or thrown down, or hit, or struck, and remaining fixed, or keeping, to his place. (TA.) [In the TA, one of the words by which it is explained is ↓ مَلْتِىٌّ ; which is for مَلْتُوءٌ; like مَقْرِىٌّ for مَقْرُوءٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
